The '''Koros Covenant''' was an agreement that took place in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] that led to the founding of the [[Star Cabal]]. Its formation occurred after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] when influential individuals such as spies, nobility, scientists and crime lords gathered in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] and formed a secret organization dedicated to the preservation of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] civilization from both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] through the control of information and influence.
